$comment: Public-domain starter library for PocketBooks. Build the PDFs with: python -m app.samples

books.title: The War of the Worlds
books.author: H. G. Wells
books.blurb: A Martian invasion seen through the eyes of an unnamed narrator fleeing across southern England. The founding text of alien-invasion science fiction.

rights.united_states: Published in 1898, long before the 1930 cut-off, so the work is in the public domain in the United States.
rights.european_union: H. G. Wells died in 1946; the 70-years-after-death term (for example German UrhG § 64) expired at the end of 2016.

books.title: The Time Machine
books.author: H. G. Wells
books.blurb: An inventor travels to the year 802,701 and finds humanity split into the gentle Eloi and the subterranean Morlocks. The book that fixed time travel as a science-fiction idea.

rights.united_states: Published in 1895, long before the 1930 cut-off, so the work is in the public domain in the United States.
rights.european_union: H. G. Wells died in 1946; the 70-years-after-death term expired at the end of 2016.

books.title: A Princess of Mars
books.author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
books.blurb: Civil War veteran John Carter wakes on Barsoom with the strength of a giant and is pulled into the wars of a dying planet. The blueprint for planetary-romance science fiction.

rights.united_states: First published in 1912, long before the 1930 cut-off, so the work is in the public domain in the United States.
rights.european_union: Edgar Rice Burroughs died in 1950; the 70-years-after-death term expired at the end of 2020.

books.title: The Thirty-Nine Steps
books.author: John Buchan
books.blurb: Richard Hannay is framed for murder and runs from both the police and a German spy ring across the Scottish moors. The original man-on-the-run secret-agent thriller.

rights.united_states: Published in 1915, long before the 1930 cut-off, so the work is in the public domain in the United States.
rights.european_union: John Buchan died in 1940; the 70-years-after-death term expired at the end of 2010.

books.title: The Riddle of the Sands
books.author: Erskine Childers
books.blurb: Two friends sailing a small yacht through the Frisian Islands stumble onto a German invasion plan. Widely regarded as the first modern espionage novel.

rights.united_states: Published in 1903, long before the 1930 cut-off, so the work is in the public domain in the United States.
rights.european_union: Erskine Childers died in 1922; the 70-years-after-death term expired at the end of 1992.
